description.value: Washtock Family Farm is a 4th-generation off-grid farm established in 1912, situated at the confluence of the Fraser and Nahatlatch Rivers near Boston Bar. The on-site camp store serves campers and passing travellers with ice, snacks, beef cuts, firewood, and eggs. The farm generates its own electricity via a Pelton wheel and offers a peaceful, remote farm-based camping experience in the Fraser Canyon.
